snippet.title: Black Lake - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Black Lake is a first-person horror game where you search for your missing twin sister inside an abandoned orphanage lost at sea. Use candles, stealth, and weapons; explore its flooded halls; uncover the fate of its vanished children; and survive the thing they became. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928600/Black_Lake/
